title: Sulfur Cube Face's
description: Gives each Sulfur Cube a unique face based on its archetype.
body:
**Sulfur Cube Archetype Faces**

Every Sulfur Cube looks the same by default, no matter what it absorbed. This mod gives each archetype its own face — bouncy, sticky, explosive, hot, etc. all look different now.

Client-side only, purely visual, doesn't touch the inner block texture or any gameplay mechanics.

All faces are regular textures, so you can override them with a resource pack — just match the file paths under assets/sulfurcubefaces/textures/entity/sulfur_cube/sulfur_cube_outer_<archetype>.png
